newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analysts' comments on Akzo Nobel results.
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on Akzo Nobel results.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group Akzo Nobel announced virtually unchanged third quarter net profits at 328 million guilders against 324 million a year earlier.
Here is a selection of analyst comments -
Henri Jongschap, chemicals analyst at ABN AMRO
The results were at the bottom of our forecast range but it's a bit of a mixed story. People were a little negative already so this is not going to lead to a bloodbath.
The chemicals results were poor but coatings was better than expected and there were promising signs we should see margins increase there.
The company has maintained its profit outlook which implies they expect a good fourth quarter.
Quirijn Mulder, analyst at ING Barings Research

Slightly disappointing results, I would have thought the chemicals division could have done better. We knew about the PVC troubles but the surface chemicals is new -- maybe there's a new problem there. Coatings slightly better than expected probably as a result of synergy benefits. I think maybe the competition particularly in the UK is not as fierce as it was. I am still rating the company as an outperformer but bringing my EPS forecast for 1996 down a little to 18.42 guilders from 18.66.
An analyst with a major Dutch investment house
Akzo's nine-month were a pleasant surprise although they came in slightly below his firm's forecast.
Akzo was going well in a difficult environment, especially the coatings side but at this stage the full year forecast would not be changed.
The first impression was these were good figures.
Andreas de Groot, analyst at MeesPierson

The results were slightly below our own estimates and they were below the market consensus. What disappointed was the chemicals activities. Fibres was as expected. Pharmaceuticals was less than the market expected. The company's still affected by the pill scare in German and the U.K. But coatings was far more postive. The main reason was the synergies and improvements from the restructuring. Our own forecasts for the full year are under review. We have (EPS of) 19 guilders. Our view is positive, mainly because of the coatings.
Patrick Rutten, analyst at F van Laschot Bankiers

I thought that coatings was quite impressive but on the other hand chemicals was quite disappointing. On fibres, I was expecting a bit more. In pharma, we hoped for better earnings. We clearly have to wait until the fourth quarter for better earnings. All in all, the result came out as expected, but the underlying result for each division was quite surprising. There's no reason to change my full year estimate (for EPS) which is 18.50 guilders.
